transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi... um. Well, I guess I just have this constant restless feeling lately. Like I'm wound a bit too tight. I just can't seem to fully settle... even when I'm supposed to be calmly sitting through a planning meeting at work, or... if I'm trying to paint, or do yoga. I just can't settle. That's mostly it.
Along with this restlessness, have you been experiencing persistent or excessive worries about everyday matters?
No... not really. I don't think I worry more than anyone else does. It's mostly just... what I said before. The restlessness.

No... not really. It's not just my legs, and it's not... uncomfortable, exactly. Just... hard to stay still.
Did you experience this kind of restlessness when you were a child?

Yes... I guess I did. I remember back in elementary school, my parents would get notes sent home. I was always... popping out of my seat, I suppose. Talking over the other kids. Rushing to answer things before the teacher was even done asking. So, yes, it's been around a while.
Do you often have difficulty maintaining your focus or sustaining attention on tasks?
No... I don't think so. I can usually get my work done just fine. Focus isn't really the issue.
